dtype_conversion: float32 before preprocessing; int8 after preprocessing
mismatch_with_t_a6: T-A6 canonical Celsius values are physically meaningful and generally outside [0,1]; runtime converts each frame to a relative min-max image before inference.
model_calibration_semantic: Existing model manifest declares normalized_thermal_frame; this does not establish T-A6 canonical-data training lineage.
observed_order: quantize with TFLite input scale and zero point

quantization.formula: round(normalized_float / input_scale + input_zero_point), then int8 clip
